name: kings-beam
description: Local scaffold for the Kings Beam calculated fan indicator

scripts.dev: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$PWD/.wrangler/config CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.toml --local --env test --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.dev:production: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$PWD/.wrangler/config CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.toml --local --env production --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run build:production && npm run build:test
scripts.build:production: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$PWD/.wrangler/config CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir dist/production
scripts.build:test: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$PWD/.wrangler/config CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler deploy --dry-run --env test --outdir dist/test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:runtime
